title: Beauty on Wheels - Vendor Service API
description:
Vendor management service for the Beauty on Wheels platform.

The Vendor Service owns:
  - Vendor onboarding and profile management
  - Vendor lifecycle and operational status
  - Vendor service areas
  - Vendor operating hours
  - Vendor staff/workers
  - Vendor capabilities and supported vehicle types
  - Vendor references to Service Catalog services/packages

The Vendor Service does NOT own:
  - Service definitions (Service Catalog Service)
  - Pricing (Pricing Service)
  - Slot availability/capacity (Availability Service)
  - Bookings (Booking Service)
  - Authentication (Identity Service)
  - Customer/user profiles (User Service)

operations.name: Createvendor
operations.description:
Creates a new vendor profile.

The authenticated identity should be linked to the vendor through ownerUserId.
Vendor creation does not automatically activate the vendor.

operations.name: Listvendors
operations.description:
Lists vendors using optional filters.
Intended primarily for admin and operational use.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor returned by the previous request

operations.name: Updatevendorstatus
operations.description:
Updates the administrative lifecycle status of a vendor.

Typical lifecycle:
  PENDING_VERIFICATION
  -> ACTIVE
  -> SUSPENDED
  -> ACTIVE
  -> INACTIVE

operations.name: Updatevendoroperationalstatus
operations.description:
Controls whether a vendor is currently accepting work.

This is different from the administrative vendor lifecycle status.

operations.name: Updatevendoroperatinghours
operations.description:
Replaces the vendor's standard weekly operating schedule.

Availability Service may use this schedule as an input when
generating or validating bookable slots.

operations.name: Deactivatevendorstaff
operations.description:
Deactivates the staff member.
Historical booking/job references should remain intact.

operations.name: Updatevendorcapabilities
operations.description:
Updates the services, packages and vehicle types that the vendor
is capable of supporting.

serviceIds and packageIds are references to entities owned by the
Service Catalog Service.

This endpoint does not define pricing or availability.

ownerUserId.description: User ID owned by User Service

userId.description:
Optional reference to User Service if the staff member
has a platform user account.

serviceIds.description: References Service Catalog Service service IDs

packageIds.description: References Service Catalog Service package IDs
